samples.summary: Fix may only close the beacon for htmlLabels-guarded (flowchart-style) labels; the repo's own notes say several diagram types emit `foreignObject` regardless of `htmlLabels`, and nothing here addresses or covers those
samples.evidence: `renderPass()` sets `htmlLabels: false` and the tests exercise a flowchart fence. But PURIFY_CONFIG's new comment (mermaid.ts:259-264) and docs/design/notes/notes.md:525-527 both state that "venn text nodes, architecture icons, kanban, sequence" append a `foreignObject` with NO `htmlLabels` guard. Those subtrees are also parsed into the live `document.body` during the layout window that the issue identifies as the fetch boundary, so if any of them can carry note-supplied markup (an `` or inline `style` with `background:url(...)`), the issue's outcome (no beacon fires from a note) is only partially met — and the change adds no mitigation, follow-up, or test for those diagram types. Could not verify against the installed engine: `mermaid` is not present in node_modules in this tree.

Nothing in CI re-measures this, and the loop is quadratic in stacked leading carriers, so the recorded figure is the only stated bound on adversarial cost. Prefer stating the complexity/bound (or capping iterations) rather than pinning machine-specific milliseconds in a comment.

verdict.reason: The reviewer's quoted evidence is accurate: renderPass() sets htmlLabels:false (mermaid.ts:473-479), and mermaid.ts:259-264 plus docs/design/notes/notes.md:525-527 both assert that venn/architecture/kanban/sequence emit a foreignObject with no htmlLabels guard. I searched wide for a counterexample and found none: (a) no upstream mitigation for those types anywhere in mermaid.ts or its callers (preview.ts, editor.ts); (b) no app-level CSP — the only CSP in the tree is frame-ancestors on the CLI login confirm middleware (backend/src/auth/cli-login-confirm.middleware.ts:166), and notes.md:523-524 states the repo has no CSP; (c) no test for a non-flowchart diagram type — every stubbed mermaid case in preview.test.ts uses a flowchart fence, and the only real-engine case (preview.test.ts:631-645) merely reads back getConfig().htmlLabels without rendering. The nearest candidate, preview.test.ts:489-505 (a stub emitting foreignObject > img), only asserts the img is absent from the persisted fragment — the very layer mermaid.ts:44-49 and notes.md:506-510 describe as NOT a fetch boundary — so it does not cover the vector claimed. (d) No follow-up task/backlog entry; grepping docs/ for 721/beacon/CSP surfaces only the two active task files, whose 'Deliberately not done' section discusses these diagram types solely to justify keeping the HTML profile. I stop short of confirming because mermaid is genuinely not installed in node_modules (only packages/notes/package.json:67 and pnpm-lock entries), so I cannot verify whether those foreignObject sites can carry note-supplied markup, and I do not have the issue's verbatim acceptance text to judge whether those diagram types fell inside its stated scope.
